questions: can i help run the museum
who takes care of the collection
answer: The Museum is being built around shared stewardship rather than a permanent central curatorial authority. Stewards may care for collections, review records, make exhibitions, document ordinary life, maintain the website and preservation systems, and take part in decisions about context, consent, and interpretation.

questions: how do i become a steward

answer: The Museum is looking for an initial group of stewards. Participation can begin with one conversation or gathering; there’s no requirement to make an ongoing commitment. Stewardship can include collection work, consent and ethics, interpretation, exhibitions, community work, infrastructure, or translation.
